meta.name: domain-voice
meta.description: Tailoring AI behavior for specific professional domains.

copy.tagline: 定制AI在特定专业领域的行为表现
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要让AI按特定行业规范输出
copy.tagline_en: Tailor AI behavior for specific professional domains
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need AI to follow specific industry norms

howto.what: 装上此技能后，Claude 会根据你指定的专业领域（如医疗、法律、创意、技术、教育）调整词汇、精确度、引用方式、风险态度等，使回复更符合该领域规范。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 以某个专业身份（如医生、律师、工程师）回答，或明确提到特定领域时触发。

say.text: 请你以医生身份帮我分析这些症状。
say.note: Claude 会采用高精确度、保守措辞并建议咨询专业人士。

say.text: 用法律顾问的口吻写一份合同条款说明。
say.note: Claude 会使用正式语态并加入免责声明。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude adapts its vocabulary, precision, citation style, risk tolerance, and authority stance based on the specified professional domain (e.g., medical, legal, creative, technical, education).
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to respond as a specific professional role or mention a particular domain.

say_en.text: Analyze these symptoms as a doctor.
say_en.note: Claude will use high precision and cautious language with medical disclaimers.

say_en.text: Explain this contract clause as a legal advisor.
say_en.note: Claude will adopt formal tone and include legal disclaimers.
